input.brief: a personal daily diary blog written at blue hour, each entry tagged with mood, weather and the song playing; readers comment; 2000s LiveJournal nostalgia, melancholic

direction.name: The dark room
direction.idea: One dark field from top to bottom, and in it, lit things. Photographs and objects appear like exhibits in a dim gallery: each with space around it, each the brightest thing on its screen. Type is light, small and sparse. The darkness is not a theme switch; it is a room, and the page is a slow walk through it. It suits subjects sold on atmosphere and material: an evening restaurant, a metal card, a record, a house at dusk.
direction.composition: A single near-black or deep-toned ground runs the full page with no section bands. First screen: either the name at full width in a light weight along the bottom edge with one dim photograph above it, or one object or photograph centred at 40–50% of the viewport with a line of text beneath at 16–18px. Each later screen holds one or two lit items at a generous size (the main one 40–60% of the screen width) with its text set beside it at full reading size; the darkness frames the items, it does not replace content. Images vary in size but all share the same darkness at their edges so they sit in the ground without frames. Practical details come last in a simple two-column text block. The only solid light element on the page is the single primary action.
direction.typography: Light or regular weights; they glow on dark. Avoid heavy bold, which looks cheap on black. Headings 4–7vw at most; text 16–18px with leading 1.6 and a slightly lifted ink (not pure white).
direction.colour: A dark ground with a tint (blue-black, green-black, brown-black), a soft light ink, a dimmer ink for secondary text, and one warm or bright accent used once per screen at most.
direction.imagery: Low-key photographs: dark backgrounds, one light source, subjects emerging from shadow. Their dark edges should blend into the page ground.
direction.photoTreatment: If a photograph's background is lighter than the page, darken the image slightly (`filter: brightness(0.85) contrast(1.05)`) rather than adding a frame.
direction.richness: Light against dark, and the slow pacing.
direction.pitfalls: Grey text on black fails contrast quickly: check it. No glow effects, no neon accent, no coloured light blobs. A dark page with a bright busy photograph is not this direction; choose low-key images. Dark does not mean empty: every screen still carries its content at a readable size, and running text is a light ink at 7:1 or more, not a dim grey.

hero.name: Text band, then sheet
hero.blueprint: A black or white field on a seven-column grid with 14px margins and 14px gaps. There is no display type: everything is set at one size, 16px, in one weight. The top band is plain text hanging from a line 20px below the top edge: the name in column one; one sentence on availability in column two; a list of five or six services from column three; a longer list of clients or awards from column five; and two links, profile and the single contact action, at the right end of column seven. Lists run one item per line. Below the lists about 300px of ground is left empty. At mid-height the sheet begins: one thumbnail per column, each the full column width (about 190px) at its natural ratio, top-aligned, with the project title in the text size above the first frame of each run of two to four frames. Rows continue below the fold with 40px between them. Frames have square corners and sit directly on the ground with no border and no caption on the image.
hero.mobile: The grid becomes two columns with 12px gaps. The name and the availability sentence take the top; services and clients sit side by side under them as two short lists at 15px. An 80px gap follows, then the sheet: two frames per row at natural ratios, each project title above its first frame. The contact action is a text link fixed bottom-right.
hero.headline: None at display size: the name is set at 16px with the rest of the text, and one sentence of up to 60 characters says what the person does.

photos.title: Water
photos.note: lakes, rivers, waterfalls and water surfaces
photos.treatment: If a photograph's background is lighter than the page, darken the image slightly (`filter: brightness(0.85) contrast(1.05)`) rather than adding a frame.

motion.name: Index with preview
motion.description: Rows of text are the navigation through the work; pointing at a row brings up its image in one fixed frame and dims the other rows. On touch screens each row shows its image inline instead. Fast and exact (about 240ms crossfade), no lag behind the pointer. Recipe: 'Index with preview, anchored to the row' in references/motion.md.

sections.name: Right-half paragraph, lone photo
sections.blueprint: No heading. On a 12-column grid with 5vw margins, one statement paragraph of 45–70 words occupies columns 7–12 only, set at clamp(24px, 2.2vw, 34px) with leading 1.25 and a first-line indent of 3em. Its top edge sits 18vh below the section top. Columns 1–6 stay empty except for a single square photograph, 20vw wide, in columns 1–3, placed so its top aligns with the paragraph's last line and it hangs below the text by most of its height. A five-line note at 14px, 180px wide, sits in columns 1–2, 96px beneath the photograph. Section padding is 160px top and bottom. Nothing is centred: the paragraph's left edge is the midpoint of the page, and later text blocks on the page may reuse that line. Holds one paragraph, one photograph and one note.
sections.mobile: The paragraph comes first at 22px, full width with 20px margins and no indent. The photograph follows at 62% width, pushed to the right margin, in a 4:5 crop instead of square. The small note sits to its left, bottom-aligned with the photograph, in the remaining 30% of the width.

sections.name: Line-up at one type size
sections.blueprint: A full-bleed flat section. The programme is a four-column table spanning the full width between 24px margins, with every cell at one size, clamp(20px, 2.1vw, 30px), one weight, no bold: the act or session flush left, the format starting at 33%, the room or stage at 66%, and the time range right-aligned at the far edge with tabular figures. Rows are 1.5em tall and separated by nothing but that leading; the fixed column starts do the organising. Day or part headings are a single line at the same size in the accent ink with 72px above and 20px below, and may be `position: sticky; top: 0` on a strip of the section's ground colour so the current day stays in view. Breaks and changeovers are rows set in capitals in the soft ink. There is no other heading. Comfortably holds 12–40 rows; with fewer than eight, raise the size to 3vw.
sections.mobile: Each entry becomes two lines: the act at 22px on the first, then format, room and time on one line at 14px in the soft ink with the time right-aligned. 18px between entries. Day headings stay sticky at the top on the ground colour.

sections.name: Band of unequal panels
sections.blueprint: A modest heading, then one wide band of pictures. The heading, two to four words at 36–44px, starts at column 3, left of centre, with 64px beneath it. The band spans the full viewport width edge to edge and is 68svh tall: four photographs standing side by side with no gaps and deliberately unequal widths, a flex row with flex-grow values of 5, 2, 3 and 2. Each panel is cropped with object-fit: cover to a tall slice, so the band reads as one folded view. The first panel carries a two-line title at 28px in paper colour at its top-left, 24px in, over a neutral scrim that covers only that corner. Hovering a panel raises its flex-grow to 6 over 500ms while the others give way; without hover the widths simply stay. One caption line at 16px sits under the band at the left margin.
sections.mobile: The heading sits on the margin at 28px. The band becomes a two-by-two block with no gaps, 84svh tall in total: the first row split 64/36 and the second 36/64, so the slices stay unequal. The title stays on the first panel. No hover behaviour.

sections.name: The email as display type
sections.blueprint: The section is 100svh in the inverse of the page's colours. A single email address is set as one line of display type spanning the content width: the font-size is fitted so the address runs from margin to margin (about 7–9vw for 20 characters; break after the @ onto two lines if it is longer than 26), light or regular weight, tight tracking, sitting on a baseline 12vh above the bottom edge. It is a `mailto:` link; on hover the whole line takes the accent ink. In the top-left corner, a sentence of up to 12 words at 20–22px says what to write about. In the two bottom corners at 14px: phone and city at the left, two or three social links at the right. No heading and no form. For a pinned ending, make the section `position: sticky; bottom: 0` beneath the page so the previous section lifts off it.
sections.mobile: The address breaks after the @ onto two lines at 11.5vw, left-aligned, sitting at 55% of an 86svh screen. The sentence sits at the top-left at 18px. Phone, city and social links stack at the bottom-left at 15px with 12px between them.

sections.name: A single quiet line
sections.blueprint: No footer block at all. After at least 30svh of empty page ground, one baseline 30px above the bottom edge carries three items in the page's ordinary small text size (14–16px), the same size and weight as the navigation: at the left margin, what this is in three or four words; centred, two to five links separated by 24px of space; at the right margin, the year and a privacy link. Use a three-column grid (1fr auto 1fr) so the centre group is truly centred whatever the side lengths. No logo, no background change, no line above it, no columns. Links are in the full ink; the rest in the softer ink. If the page has a narrow text column, the three items may instead sit on that column's left edge as one wrapped line. The restraint only works if the page above has already made its invitation.
sections.mobile: Three short lines at 14px on the left margin with 8px between them: the description, the links on one wrapped line, then year and privacy. Links stay in the full ink. Leave 20svh of empty ground above and 24px below.

references.name: IZANAMI
references.idea: Silence as design: one small sentence in fog, then a slow descent from mist into a dark glass pavilion.
references.hero: After a warm-black loader showing only one 18px serif sentence and a small counter, the hero is a full-bleed, desaturated grey-green image of pine forest dissolving into fog. The same sentence stays at 18px in white, left-aligned on a line about 17% from the left edge and exactly at vertical centre; it is the only text in the picture area. A small white seal-style logo sits top-left; a language switch and menu label in tiny tracked capitals sit top-right, each with a dot above. Along the bottom edge: copyright, two live city clocks, and a scroll cue at far right, all near 10px.
references.type: Playfair Display regular for the few headings, only 18 to 45px (3.1vw at most); Shippori Mincho for body at 14px; Cinzel capitals with wide tracking for nav, clocks and footer. Nothing is large: hierarchy comes from isolation rather than size.
references.colour: #0a0801 #6f7a70 #b7b5a6 #d9d2c3 #4b5b39 — Warm near-black panels and grey-green fog imagery with off-white text at reduced opacity. Moss green and sand from the small garden photos are the only colour; there is no accent.
references.imagery: Fog-bound forest, a black-framed glass pavilion seen in one-point perspective, and small crops of incense smoke, a bamboo water spout and raked gravel. Small images are square-cornered, portrait or square, overlapping one another and the dark ceiling plane.
references.layout: Wide margins, with text hung on an inner line about 17% across instead of the page edge. Most screens hold one image and one short text; small photos are placed asymmetrically near corners and overlap. A rotated section label runs down the left edge.

sections.description: Over the black ceiling of the pavilion image, a three-line serif heading at about 3vw sits left of centre, each line indented further than the one above. Faint body text follows below it. A small square photo sits top-left under the logo; at right, three portrait photos overlap in a cluster, two beige garden shots behind and a narrower green water-ripple image in front and raised higher, running off the bottom edge.

Full-bleed one-point-perspective view down a glass corridor, its ceiling filling the upper half as near-black. A text link with a short leading rule sits top-left on the inner line; a landscape photo of raked gravel is tucked against the top edge right of centre; a three-line heading fades in low and left of centre over the glass. A section name rotated ninety degrees runs down the far left.

Near-black and almost empty. One section name in serif at about 24px, preceded by a long thin rule, sits at mid-height left of centre. Lower down, tiny tracked-capital columns: a nav list, two office addresses side by side, and social links pushed to the far right. The bottom edge repeats the copyright and the two city clocks.

steal: Place a single 18px sentence at vertical centre on an offset left line over full-bleed fog, and let the absence of a headline be the statement.
Stair-step a three-line heading by indenting each line further than the one above it.
Run two live city clocks with time-zone labels along the bottom edge as quiet proof of where the firm operates.
references.media: A misted forest photograph covers the whole first screen under drifting cloud layers, with text on about 0.2% of the area. Then a pinned full-screen architectural scene dollies forward while overlapping collages of two or three photographs at different widths pass over it, rows pair a text column at about 28vw with a portrait flush to the right margin, and the fog band returns as a bookend; about 11 photographs, one WebGL canvas, no video.
references.motion: A warm near-black screen with the tagline already in place until about 2.5s, then a fog bank creeps in from the lower right and the chrome fades in by 4.5s; load took 7.2s. Lenis with three sticky sections scrubs the scene as the forest darkens and the camera sinks into the pavilion, photographs move at different rates, and headline lines fade in one by one; two cloud layers loop on 100s linear translates, and there is no reduced-motion rule.

references.name: Cipher
references.idea: The showreel as a slowly turning wreath: a dozen film stills overlap in an elliptical ring around a tiny emblem on a black screen, with almost no text.
references.hero: The first capture is the preloader: a black screen textured with a fine grid of grey dots that thins out towards the right, the wordmark top-left and a tiny copyright glyph dead centre. Once loaded, the black screen holds a ring of about fourteen landscape film stills, each roughly 10% of the viewport wide, overlapping one another around an ellipse about 35% of the width; the centre is empty except for a 20px white emblem. The wordmark, about 11% wide, stays top-left. Four 9px uppercase links are split: one at the horizontal centre, three at the far right. A partner mark sits bottom-right. There is no headline.
references.type: Favorit only, and only at about 11px: uppercase nav links with slight tracking. The custom wordmark, with a macron and a schwa among its letters, is the sole large letterform. No headline and no body copy; one type size on the page.
references.colour: #070604 #ffffff #c9a45a #2f55c8 #c96a1e — Near-black ground with white micro-type. All colour comes from the stills: gold, cobalt blue, orange, garden green, plus one black-and-white frame.
references.imagery: Stills from fashion, beauty and fragrance films in 3:2 landscape crops, square-cornered and unframed, layered so each overlaps its neighbour by about a third. No captions or titles on them.
references.layout: A single non-scrolling stage. Navigation is pushed to the corners at tiny size and the ring of stills occupies the middle third; over half the screen is empty black. Scrolling rotates the ring instead of moving the page.
steal: Arrange work thumbnails as an overlapping elliptical ring with an empty centre, and bind scroll to rotation instead of vertical travel.
Shrink all text to one 11px uppercase size and let a custom wordmark be the only large type.
Give the preloader its own texture (a dot grid fading across the screen) rather than a spinner or percentage.
references.media: There is no document: one fixed canvas holds every picture as a texture, a ring of overlapping 16:9 film stills (about 240x135, overlapping their neighbours by 20-40%) round a tiny emblem, covering about 62% by 69% of the viewport, with the tiles themselves on 35-40% of the area and warm black between. No video elements; at least 35 distinct stills cycle through the ring.
references.motion: The dot-grid loader with a spinning chrome letter is still up at 4.5s. After that the wheel turns the ring instead of the page, sliding new stills in along the circular path with no fade or mask; nav letters roll on hover, and the few CSS transitions are transform .45s cubic-bezier(.83,.12,.35,.96) and opacity .2-.3s.

references.name: Marina Rachello
references.idea: The surname is broken with a hyphen so its tail becomes a greeting, set huge in a soft bookish serif on a red field, and the page signs off with an even larger goodbye.
references.hero: Solid red-orange viewport with no navigation: only two tiny pale labels in the top corners (role at left, employer at right). The name starts about 15% down, left-aligned from a 3% margin, in a soft, slightly blobby bold serif at roughly 14vw. Line one, in cream, breaks the surname with a hyphen about 84% across; line two, in near-black, completes it as a greeting with an exclamation mark, leaded so tightly the lines nearly touch. Together they fill the top 55% of the screen. A right-aligned two-paragraph bio in small white sans, about 24% wide, sits in the bottom-right corner. The bottom-left is empty.
references.type: Averia Serif Libre bold, a soft-edged averaged serif, at about 14vw in the hero and 26vw in the footer marquee; DM Sans 18px for the bio and the tiny corner labels. Only three sizes exist, with a display-to-body jump above 10x. Mixed case, default tracking.
references.colour: #e84025 #2a2a2a #f3ede4 #1a1919 #d5d5d5 — Hot red-orange bookends the page as hero and footer; the work area between is flat charcoal so the project boards supply their own colour. Type is cream and near-black on red.
references.imagery: Project presentation boards: composed collages of UI screens on coloured grounds, plus one photo of a device in use. Landscape tiles around 16:10 with square corners, lined up in a single horizontal row with narrow gaps on charcoal.
references.layout: Three acts: a red type poster, a long charcoal stretch where one row of large landscape boards travels sideways with empty charcoal above and below, then a red footer. Outer margins are tight at about 3%; there are no headings between acts.

sections.description: On flat charcoal, a single horizontal strip of project boards is vertically centred with about 20% empty space above and below. Each board is roughly 62% of the viewport wide and 58% tall with 24px gaps, so one full board and the cropped edge of the next are always in view. No captions, titles or buttons accompany them; the strip slides sideways while the page scrolls for about ten screens.

A red block rises from the charcoal with a hard straight edge. A farewell phrase in the same serif at 26vw runs as one cream line far wider than the viewport, cropped at the right edge. Beneath it three small white text links with arrow glyphs are stacked and centred, and a tiny copyright line sits at the very bottom.

steal: Find a word hiding inside the name and split it across two lines with a hyphen and a colour change, so the headline is both the name and a greeting.
Park the bio as a small right-aligned paragraph in the bottom-right corner, diagonally opposite the giant left-aligned name, and leave the other two corners empty.
Bookend a neutral dark work area with the same saturated colour field and the same display face, set even larger for the goodbye than for the hello.
